title: Australian Broadcasting Corporation Amendment (Appointment of Directors) Bill 2018
short_title: Australian Broadcasting Corporation Amendment (Appointment of Directors) Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill aims to make the process for choosing non-executive members of the ABC's board more independent and transparent.
It would change the appointment rules to match the merit-based system that was introduced by a 2012 law.
The new rules would start the day after the bill becomes law.
changes: It would strengthen the independence and autonomy of the director appointment process.
It would increase transparency and integrity in how non-executive directors are chosen.
It would align the appointment process with the merit-based arrangements from 2012.
summary.affected: The ABC and the people appointed as non-executive directors to its board.
